mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cp.id, cp.name_cn, cp.name_jp, cp.name_en, cp.band_id, cp.school, cp.role, cp.instrument, cp.stage_name, cp.summary FROM character_profile cp JOIN timeline_character_state tcs ON cp.id = tcs.character_id WHERE tcs.timeline_id = #{timelineId}
SELECT id, timeline_id, character_id, state_description, personality_adjust, speech_adjust FROM timeline_character_state WHERE timeline_id = #{timelineId} AND character_id = #{characterId}
SELECT id, character_id, trait, sort_order FROM personality_trait WHERE character_id = #{characterId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT id, character_id, detail, sort_order FROM character_detail WHERE character_id = #{characterId} ORDER BY sort_order
